subject: Trading
title: Broker Quality Matters
description: A quick, practical guide to Broker Quality Matters.

hook.text: Some forex brokers trade against you. When you lose, they profit directly. It's legal in many jurisdictions.

buildup.text: Market-maker brokers take the other side of your trade internally. B-book models mean your loss is their gain.

discovery.text: ECN/STP brokers route your orders to real liquidity providers. They earn from spreads, not your losses.

twist.text: Regulation varies wildly. A broker licensed in the UK follows strict rules; one offshore may follow none.

climax.text: Your broker is your most important counterparty. A bad broker can cost you more than bad trades ever will.

punchline.text: Don't let your broker be your biggest risk.

quiz.question: What is a 'B-book' forex broker model?
options: The broker takes the opposite side of your trade and profits from your losses
